label_note: Labels are given only as each paper states them. Perez-Vega et al. 2026 (J Phycol 62:1367-1382, doi 10.1111/jpy.70201) equate Group III of Rene et al. 2013 with the American/Malaysian ribotype of Iwataki et al. 2008; the linkage does not apply this mapping.
limitations: Strains are linked to GenBank records by name alone; a shared name does not prove the same culture.
CP-1 matches GenBank strain CP1 by name, but the CP1 record comes from a phylogeny paper and is not confirmed to be the Griffith and Gobler culture.
The MP-LRCB-082419 name, origin and methods come from the authors' PANGAEA dataset (doi 10.1594/PANGAEA.974726); the abstract does not name the strain.
Entries marked abstract were curated from the abstract only; optima and rates not stated there are omitted.
Growth conditions (medium, irradiance, photoperiod) differ between studies, so responses are not directly comparable.
Only six named strains with laboratory growth data were found; none from Puerto Rico, Mexico, China or the Mediterranean.
Kim et al. 2004 (J Plankton Res 26:61-66) is omitted because its strain name could not be verified.
